news_cards.title: **Bihar to become Steel Hub with Rs 51,600 Crore Investment**
bullets: **MoU signed with major industrial groups**: Dainik Bhaskar reports that the Bihar government has signed MoUs with major industrial groups to invest Rs 51,600 crore in the state, making it a steel hub.
**Textile and Nuclear Energy sectors to get boost**: The investment will also boost the textile and nuclear energy sectors in the state.
**51600 Crore investment to create jobs and stimulate economy**: The investment is expected to create jobs and stimulate the economy of the state.

news_cards.title: **Free Steamboat Ferry Service launched in Narsarigunj-Panapur**
bullets: **Free Steamboat Ferry Service to ease transportation**: The Bihar government has launched a free steamboat ferry service in Narsarigunj-Panapur to ease transportation and boost economic activities.
**Simplified travel and increased economic activity**: The service is expected to simplify travel and increase economic activity in the region.
**Rs 6 Crore allocated for the project**: The project has been allocated Rs 6 crore for its implementation.

bullets: **65 km Ganga Channel to be developed**: The Bihar government has decided to develop a 65 km Ganga channel as part of the JP Ganga Path project.
